items.title: Footprint — E-Commerce Footwear Platform
items.shortDesc: Full-stack footwear e-commerce storefront & operations platform with Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot security, Pathao courier logistics, and Dockerized Render deployment.
items.desc: A production-grade footwear e-commerce storefront and admin operations platform. Features responsive catalog browsing, shopping cart, checkout protected with Cloudflare Turnstile anti-abuse bot mitigation, automated Pathao courier logistics integration, admin inventory management, Supabase S3 storage, Microsoft Clarity session analytics, and real-time Sentry error tracking. Containerized with Docker and deployed on Render with 24/7 uptime monitoring.
highlights: Secured checkout with Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot mitigation and server-side token validation
Automated logistics API integration with Pathao Courier for one-click consignment dispatch and live tracking
Multi-stage Docker containerization running Bun + Hono API and React SPA on Render with Supabase PostgreSQL & S3
Comprehensive observability with real-time Sentry exception tracking and 24/7 UptimeRobot health monitoring

items.title: Tamurfood — B2B Bakery Ordering
items.shortDesc: B2B bakery ordering platform with real-time SSE kitchen order fulfillment, per-shop 'Khata' credit ledger, and Dockerized 24/7 cloud deployment.
items.desc: A full-stack B2B ordering platform for a neighbourhood bakery, containerized with Docker and deployed on Render with 24/7 uptime monitoring. Nearby shops order from a live menu; bakery staff fulfil and deliver in real time. Features three-tier role-based access (admin/moderator/shop), real-time order updates over SSE, a per-shop "Khata" credit ledger with partial payments, concurrency-safe inventory, Supabase S3 image storage, and Sentry exception tracking.
highlights: Real-time order push updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instant kitchen staff dispatch and live fulfillment
Concurrency-safe daily menu ordering with atomic stock inventory management in PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM
Financial Khata credit ledger system tracking shop debt, partial repayments, and running transaction history
Containerized Docker deployment on Render with automated database migrations, Supabase S3 media storage, and Sentry tracking

items.title: DeshGhuri — Travel Marketplace
items.shortDesc: Travel marketplace platform for verified tours and bookings, built with React, TanStack Router, Hono, and PostgreSQL.
items.desc: Wrote the PRD and managed feature breakdown in ClickUp. My contribution: seller authentication routes, seller dashboard backend API, and admin verification system. Collaborated with 2 teammates using Git branching workflow.
highlights: Engineered secure seller authentication flows (signup, session management) with Hono and Zod schema validation
Built seller dashboard backend API for booking metrics, revenue analytics, and tour listings with Drizzle ORM
Integrated Supabase Storage for tour media and developed admin verification review workflow
Collaborated in an agile 3-developer team utilizing Git branching, ClickUp sprints, and pull request reviews

items.title: Agrifood Blockchain Supply Chain
items.shortDesc: Permissioned enterprise blockchain network for end-to-end agricultural supply chain traceability (B.Sc. Thesis Project).
items.desc: Designed the traceability workflow for farmer → retailer → customer lifecycle. Understood and documented Hyperledger Fabric concepts. Contributed to testing, documentation, and thesis presentation. Chaincode was AI-assisted.
highlights: Designed transparent product traceability lifecycle spanning Farmer → Distributor → Retailer → Consumer
Modeled multi-organization Hyperledger Fabric network with private data collections and Raft consensus
Conducted performance, throughput, and transaction latency benchmarking using Hyperledger Caliper
Published and defended academic thesis with complete Docker Compose network deployment scripts

items.title: Lung Cancer Detection — Ensemble CNNs
items.shortDesc: Medical image classification pipeline combining Xception and ResNet50 ensemble deep learning architectures.
items.desc: Academic project combining Xception and ResNet50 for medical image classification. Worked on dataset preparation, training workflow, and evaluation metrics. Note: academic learning project only.
highlights: Constructed an ensemble transfer learning pipeline combining pre-trained Xception and ResNet50 convolutional networks
Engineered data augmentation and preprocessing workflows for pulmonary computed tomography (CT) scan images
Evaluated model classification performance using multi-class accuracy, precision, recall, and ROC-AUC metrics
Academic project exploring computer vision and transfer learning applications in medical diagnostics
